description.narrative: The partner organisation is the National Union of Ghana Students (NUGS). The destination is Accra, the capital of Ghana. NUGS is the main representative body of students, including the ones equivalent to the students represented by EEO in Denmark. The goal is to test the applicability of the project in local vocational schools. The overall purpose of the project is to initiate democratic thinking in vocational schools in Ghana and to inspire engagement with democracy. It’s important to engage students in democracy and to promote political thought, therefore we are seeking a partnership for our project on day of democracy in Ghana. The goal of our project is to plan and hold the day of democracy at local vocational schools, inspired by DUFs “Demokratiets Dag”. In collaboration with NUGS we will develop a concept tailored for vocational schools in Ghana. We believe that it’s essential to have engaging workshops that are relevant for the students we are trying to reach. The idea is to bring democracy to the students and make it relevant to them. When the material and the concept is ready, we will coordinate the events with local schools and / or relevant authorities. The purpose of the partnership identification is to: 1) Explore whether NUGS and EEO are compatible for a collaborative project, develop the partnership and discuss a partnership agreement for further work on the project. Another benefit of the partnership identification is establishing more mutual knowledge on the organisations and to establish a bond between the volunteers from EEO and NUGS. Furthermore, we wish to tailor the project to suit our expectations along with the expectations from our partner organisation, and make sure it has the impact we strive for. Therefore, the overall project may change after the partnership identification. 2) Test the practical application of the events as a proof of concept in Ghana. We intend to practise and facilitate workshops with the volunteers from NUGS to inspire them. Following the workshop, we will evaluate the concept and make adjustments to suit the best practices for the project.
